findings.verbatim: ru renders "this login" as "этот логин" while the namespace renders login as "вход" (head_finite_share "Поделиться входом", not_copied "Ваш вход", needs_broker "заимствовать входы"). In Russian UI "логин" commonly means the account username, so the object of consent becomes ambiguous; this is the only "логин" in ui.mesh.
findings.recommendation: Use the namespace term, e.g. "Сессии на {device} могут заимствовать этот вход с доступом, привязанным к каждой сессии."
findings.disposition: not applied: auditors never edit translations; handed to the implementer for one batched remediation or explicit deferral. Nonblocking: no security-consent consequence is reversed or omitted.

findings.verbatim: English says sessions can BORROW; ru says "могут использовать" (use), whereas needs_broker renders borrow as "заимствовать". The all-sessions, per-session-bound scope is preserved; the borrow nuance and term link are lost. scope_device "любая сессия" now matches glossary сессия (TA2-RU-01 resolved).
